claims: Netflix does not offer a free trial in 2026
Netflix discontinued the free trial program in October 2020
There are no official active trial periods for new or returning users in the U.S.
Netflix users are required to pay immediately
Netflix users can cancel at any time to avoid future charges
Select plans from providers like T-Mobile or Verizon provide access to Netflix at no extra cost
Netflix's website sometimes provides a selection of episodes from popular shows to stream for free
Using a Netflix gift card allows for prepaid access without a continuous automatic subscription
Scams claiming to offer free trials are often fraudulent according to Spliiit
The only official way to sign up for Netflix is through netflix.com/signup
